title: Australia’s Biggest (Virtual) Morning Tea: News Story
author: Aaron
body:
The Cancer Council’s annual Australia’s Biggest Morning Tea took a virtual turn this year, as ATG logged onto Zoom to come together and make a difference to those impacted by cancer.

Under normal circumstances, ATG staff take part in its most successful annual fundraiser: Australia’s Biggest Morning Tea. Staff contribute by baking cakes, slices and muffins for the bake sale, by buying baked goods, and by purchasing raffle tickets. Local businesses also partake in the fundraiser by donating food, drinks and prizes.

Because of social restrictions in place due to COVID-19, it was decided by OneTomorrow and ATG staff that we still needed to do something. And thanks to the magic of technology, we could. On Tuesday 28th May 2020, instead of our usual in-office bake sale fundraiser, we jumped online with our home-brewed cuppas and joined one another in the virtual realm to raise money for cancer research. Hosted by APT Travel Group Director Rob McGeary and the OneTomorrow committee, the event was a great success.

As well as spot prizes and games, we also welcomed special guest speaker Professor Gary Richardson, Director of Oncology Clinics Victoria, who spoke about the latest challenges for cancer research due to COVID-19.

Thanks to the generosity of all who participated and made donations, and with OneTomorrow matching the money raised, we raised $1,730 for cancer research.
